baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ ... يَرَىٰ nests the subject's knowing inside Allah's seeing.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge as disclosure and sight as ocular or inward perception form a reflexive accountability loop: the subject is asked whether what should be clear to him includes the fact that he is already perceptible to another.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as a thing disclosed to the knower supplies the human recognition demanded by the question.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the encompassing perception to which the subject's knowledge must answer.

changed_reading.before: A general reminder that Allah is aware of what happens.
changed_reading.after: The question exposes a practical contradiction: the subject can know that he is seen yet act as though that knowledge never entered conduct.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَعْلَم and يَرَىٰ can meet through the branch images of a distinguishing mark and a visible appearance.
baseline_models.mechanism: A mark makes something identifiable and directs an observer toward it; sight receives that marked appearance. The verse can therefore present conduct not merely as privately known but as becoming its own visible evidence.

activation_trace.role: The distinguishing mark that points to a thing turns knowledge into legibility and makes conduct evidentiary.
Visible appearance and mirror imagery supply the field in which the subject's own marks return to view.

changed_reading.before: Allah invisibly knows an otherwise concealable act.
changed_reading.after: The act marks and displays its agent; Allah's seeing reads an evidence-bearing appearance rather than merely penetrating a secret.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The named worshipped one is the grammatical seer, while the sight inventory also contains action performed for people's gaze.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can stage a competition between audiences. If conduct is adjusted for human spectators, the question displaces that social gaze with the gaze of the one to whom worship is due.

activation_trace.role: Worship and the worshipped one establish the authority of the audience named as seer.
Showing an act before people supplies a rival audience whose approval can be displaced by divine sight.

changed_reading.before: The verse adds an unseen observer to the scene.
changed_reading.after: The verse asks why the subject lets a lesser audience govern conduct while ignoring the worshipped witness already seeing it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The form يَرَىٰ is anchored in sight, while both mapped inventories open reflective judgment and considered deliberation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sight can be carried forward into evaluation: what is seen is not only registered but weighed. The non-dominant mapped root strengthens a judicial shade without replacing the focus verb's ordinary visual anchor.

activation_trace.role: Reflective opinion and judgment make seeing capable of issuing in an assessment.
The non-dominant image of considered deliberation adds a cautious sense of sight becoming a weighed verdict.
The fixed divine name identifies whose seeing can carry authoritative evaluative force.

changed_reading.after: Allah's seeing is carried as observation already tending toward deliberation and verdict.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated reading, teaching, and the writing instrument make knowledge an imparted capacity with a material trace. When يَعْلَم returns in the focus, the question sounds less like a request for missing information and more like an indictment generated by the very faculty the subject received.

activation_trace.role: Disclosed knowledge anchors the focus question in an epistemic capacity already available to the subject.
Divine perception names the fact that the taught capacity should disclose.
Reading and recitation begin the sequence as an exercised mode of receiving and voicing knowledge.
The repeated reading image makes instruction persistent rather than incidental.
Teaching as disclosure supplies the giver-side origin of the knowing later demanded.
The paired teaching and knowing occurrences frame human knowledge as movement out of prior non-disclosure.
The pared writing stick gives instruction a durable, inspectable medium and supports the later theme of legibility.

structural_cues: The commands to read at 96:1 and 96:3 precede teaching by the pen at 96:4.
At 96:5, teaching and the learner's former non-knowing use the same root that returns as يَعْلَم in 96:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated reading, teaching, knowing, and pen images; I infer that received knowledge creates accountability, so the focus charges misuse rather than mere ignorance. A live alternative is that the sequence only identifies knowledge's source without making the subject's failure willful.

changed_reading.before: The subject lacks or suppresses one fact about divine observation.
changed_reading.after: A creature equipped to read, learn, and inscribe is convicted by its own taught capacity when it fails to let divine seeing govern action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured creation and attachment establish dependent origin; transgression as boundary-crossing or overflowing force follows a self-assessment of sufficiency. The focus question exposes this autonomy as an epistemic severing from relations that still hold.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as disclosure anchors the contradiction between actual dependence and the subject's practical self-conception.
Divine sight supplies the encompassing relation that the claim of autonomy fails to escape.
Bringing creation into being supplies a received rather than self-originating existence.
Attachment and clinging make dependency the material counter-image to imagined self-sufficiency.
Crossing the limit in disobedience gives the false autonomy its behavioral effect.
Overflowing water and sweeping force materialize self-expansion beyond a containing boundary.
Self-sufficiency names the mistaken independence that triggers the overflow.

structural_cues: Creation and attachment occupy 96:1-2, while transgression and self-sufficiency occupy 96:6-7.
The focus question later places the supposedly sufficient subject inside another's field of sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies created attachment, overflow, and self-sufficiency; I infer a causal arrow from mis-seeing dependence to transgression, with divine sight restoring the omitted relation. A live alternative is that sufficiency is only situational or economic, not an ontological claim.

changed_reading.before: An autonomous wrongdoer happens to be watched.
changed_reading.after: The watched subject's wrongdoing is the performance of an impossible independence: one formed in attachment tries to act outside the relation that still sees and contains him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The root of seeing moves from self-appraisal, through repeated alerting questions addressed to a witness, to Allah as seer. The focus is therefore the reversal point where the subject's verdict about himself becomes an object inside a larger gaze.

activation_trace.role: Disclosed knowledge asks whether the subject recognizes the reversal from seeing himself to being seen.
Seeing by eye or insight anchors the final and encompassing side of the gaze reversal.
Reflective judgment makes the subject's seeing of himself a self-authored verdict rather than neutral perception.
Self-sufficiency supplies the content of the subject's self-verdict.
The tell-me alerting formula turns seeing outward and recruits the addressee to inspect the scene.
The repeated alert renews inspection while testing an alternative account of the act.
The third alert completes the human witnessing sequence immediately before divine sight is named.

structural_cues: 96:7 contains self-seeing, 96:9, 96:11, and 96:13 repeat the alerting أَرَءَيْتَ, and 96:14 ends with Allah seeing.
The subject, addressee, and Allah occupy successively wider positions in the same root's visual field.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered seeing forms and the self-sufficiency predicate; I infer an optical reversal from self-verdict to inspected scene to divine gaze. A live alternative is that the repeated forms are discourse prompts with no designed expansion of viewpoint.

changed_reading.before: The line introduces divine observation after a series of rhetorical questions.
changed_reading.after: The line overturns the subject's self-seeing: the one who pronounced himself sufficient is himself contained in the sight he failed to include.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prohibition confronts worship, while guidance and protective command are set against denial and turning away. In that contest of directives, Allah's seeing functions as the superior witness that makes one party's attempted authority answerable to another jurisdiction.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped one supplies the higher authority whose sight evaluates the attempted prohibition.
Reflective judgment lets divine seeing operate as assessment within the authority conflict.
Restraint and prohibition supply the coercive command whose legitimacy is at issue.
Submissive worship identifies the relation the prohibitor attempts to interrupt.
The specified worship practice gives the prohibited submission a concrete enacted form.
Gentle direction toward path and truth supplies the possible right orientation of the prohibited actor.
Demand and obligation introduce a competing command aligned with protection rather than obstruction.
Repelling harm by protection gives the alternative command its safeguarding purpose.
Attributing falsehood supplies the rejection by which the rival authority defends itself.
Turning away and retreating complete the rejecting side of the authority conflict.

structural_cues: 96:9-10 places an act of prohibition directly against a servant's prayer.
96:11-13 tests guidance and protective command against denial and turning away before 96:14 names the divine seer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed commands, worship, guidance, denial, and turning; I infer that seeing confers witness and jurisdiction over their conflict. A live alternative is that sight only guarantees factual awareness and that adjudicative force arrives later rather than inside 96:14.

changed_reading.before: Allah sees an individual's bad act.
changed_reading.after: Allah witnesses a struggle over who may command worship, and the question voids the coercer's claim to act as the scene's highest authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus roots already allow a mark read through visible appearance. The following seizure of the forelock and its predicates of lying and missing the right transform moral concealment into an embodied, graspable exhibit.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark supplies the evidentiary transition from knowing to identifying the agent.
Visible appearance and mirror imagery provide the surface on which moral traits become readable.
Taking by the forelock converts observed liability into physical apprehension at a visible bodily point.
The forelock and seizure image identifies the bodily locus where the seen agent becomes graspable.
The repeated forelock holds the bodily exhibit in view while predicates are attached to it.
The contrary-to-truth image labels the seized exterior with the agent's epistemic failure.
Missing the right target makes error directional and completes the body's evidentiary description.

structural_cues: The conditional warning in 96:15 follows immediately after the question about divine sight.
96:15-16 repeats the forelock and then grammatically attaches lying and error to that bodily locus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mark, appearance, forelock seizure, lie, and error images; I infer that divine sight first renders guilt legible and the sequel then materializes that legibility on the body. A live alternative is that the body imagery is punishment alone, without a forensic relation to the focus roots.

changed_reading.before: Divine sight detects an inwardly hidden wrong.
changed_reading.after: Divine sight makes the wrongdoer self-disclosing: lie and error become a visible mark that can be named and physically apprehended.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering and recitation at the opening are answered near the close by two opposed calls: one summons an assembly, the other summons agents of pushing and prevention. Allah's seeing becomes the hinge that turns attempted local mobilization into an exposed public confrontation.

activation_trace.role: Mutual visibility and facing supply the exposed confrontation into which the competing summons develop.
Gathering and collection establish an opening social image later echoed by rival mobilizations.
Calling by raised speech supplies the subject's attempt to mobilize support.
The council or gathered assembly gives the first call a concrete social body.
The answering call mirrors and overtakes the subject's attempted summons.
Pushing, collision, and prevention give the counter-summoned body its restraining function.

structural_cues: 96:17 and 96:18 place two calls in immediate antiphonal sequence.
The first call names the subject's assembly; the second names a body characterized by forceful prevention.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, two calls, an assembly, and pushing agents; I infer that the divine gaze exposes and answers a social power play rather than merely observing a private act. A live alternative is that the opening gathering image is unrelated and only the two closing summons form the contrast.

changed_reading.before: The focus addresses a solitary conscience under observation.
changed_reading.after: The focus exposes a bid for collective power and marks the moment when a local summons becomes visible within a stronger counter-summons.

context_deltas.mechanism: Height and overflowing rise are set against the closing movement of lowering and approaching. A faint non-dominant extension image inside the obedience cue intensifies the contrast. Divine sight measures these vectors differently: self-elevation produces transgressive distance, while bodily descent produces nearness.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped one supplies the relational center relative to which elevation and approach are measured.
Divine sight observes the opposed bodily and moral directions rather than equating height with rank.
Elevation and height establish the vertical image at the opening.
Water rising into sweeping overflow makes transgression an uncontrolled upward excess.
The non-dominant extension and rising image adds a remote vertical echo inside the rejected obedience relation.
Lowering and humility reverse the transgressor's upward overflow through chosen descent.
Nearness supplies the paradoxical result of lowering: descent closes rather than increases distance.

structural_cues: An opening height image is followed by transgressive overflow and finally by prostration plus approach.
The final imperatives place refusal of obedience, bodily lowering, and nearness in one compressed sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies height, overflow, extension, lowering, and nearness; I infer a spatial value reversal in which divine sight distinguishes arrogant rise from approaching descent. A live alternative is that these branch images are independent lexical resonances, especially the non-dominant ط و ع mapping, and do not form one vertical architecture.

changed_reading.before: Allah sees whether the subject obeys.
changed_reading.after: Allah's sight reveals that apparent elevation can be distance and apparent abasement can be approach; the question silently tests the direction of the subject's movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sovereignty, return, terminal boundary, and approaching time form an accountability arc around the focus. Divine seeing is not a static camera within that arc; it is the impossibility of escaping by delay because conduct remains visible as return and limit draw nearer.

activation_trace.role: Continuous perception anchors the claim that temporal delay does not create an unseen interval.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the destination of return as an authoritative center.
Returning to a prior point gives accountability a directed temporal movement.
The endpoint at which a thing terminates turns failure to desist into collision with a limit.
Approaching time and a thing's completion make the final nearness temporal as well as spatial.

structural_cues: Return appears at 96:8 before the focus, while termination at 96:15 and approach at 96:19 follow it.
The focus sits between the announcement of return and the sequence in which evasion meets limit and nearness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sovereign return, endpoint, and approaching completion; I infer that seeing links them into a no-escape temporal arc. A live alternative is that return, stopping, and approach refer to distinct relations and that sight itself remains temporally neutral.

changed_reading.before: The subject is observed in the present moment.
changed_reading.after: The subject is visible across an arc already closing toward return and limit, so postponement cannot manufacture an outside to divine sight.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protection before the focus and the final refusal, prostration, and approach after it reverse the emotional valence of being seen. The same gaze that exposes the coercer can shelter the one who refuses coercive obedience and continues worship.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped one anchors the loyal relation within which being seen can be protective rather than merely threatening.
Divine perception supplies oversight shared by both the coercer and the protected worshipper.
Repelling harm by a protective barrier opens the possibility that divine oversight safeguards right action.
Submission and obedience identify the human demand that must be refused in favor of the higher relation.
Humble lowering supplies the worshipper's enacted alternative to coerced compliance.
Nearness makes continued worship under observation a movement toward safety and relation.

structural_cues: Protective command is considered at 96:12 before Allah's seeing is named.
The closing sequence rejects obedience to the prohibitor and immediately commands prostration and approach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protection, refusal of obedience, prostration, and nearness; I infer that the gaze has a protective face for the worshipper as well as an exposing face for the coercer. A live alternative is that protection belongs only to the commanded virtue and divine sight remains affectively neutral.

changed_reading.before: Being seen is only a threat directed at wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: Being seen has two live valences: it exposes coercion while assuring the worshipper that refusal, prostration, and approach occur under protective oversight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the ء ن س image of the human reflected in the pupil is an optical lexical branch, not a claim about the focus verb. It remains anchored by repeated إِنسَان and the focus inventory's visible-appearance branch. Render it only as a metaphor for inescapable inclusion in the field of sight, never as divine anatomy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَرَىٰ anchors sight, while the repeated human noun supplies an image of the human already lodged in what sees.

activation_trace.role: Visible appearance and mirror imagery provide the optical field in which a human image can be held.
The human of the eye and reflected image makes created humanity an object already present within vision.
The repeated human-image branch carries the optical metaphor into the teaching sequence.
Its third occurrence places the transgressing human, not an abstract deed alone, inside the visual field.

changed_reading.before: A human stands outside and is looked at by an observer.
changed_reading.after: As a contained optical metaphor, the human becomes the image held within sight and cannot step outside the very field in which he appears.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading depends on the non-dominant ر و ي branch of transmitting reports and is therefore branch-distant. It remains anchored in focus يَرَىٰ and is activated by reading, teaching-marks, and the pen. Render it as an abductive model of acts becoming recordable and transmissible, not as a lexical replacement of seeing with narration.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus sight root's split mapping opens report transmission, while يَعْلَم supplies legibility and disclosure.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant image of relaying reports turns what is seen into something capable of transmission.
A distinguishing mark makes the observed act identifiable enough to enter a report.
Reading and recitation supply the voiced retrieval side of a transmissible record.
Teaching through a mark links imparted knowledge with externally recoverable signs.
The pared writing instrument supplies the material channel through which a seen mark can persist and be relayed.

changed_reading.before: The act is seen only in the instant it occurs.
changed_reading.after: The act becomes legible, recordable, and reportable: divine sight initiates a chain in which the event cannot disappear when the moment passes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a deliberately cross-domain hydraulic activation built from distant focus branches of gathered water and quenching plus context images of overflow, returned water, and water-seeking. Its coherence is structural rather than lexical. Preserve it only as a qualified analogy for false self-filling inside a larger containing circulation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus يَعْلَم and يَرَىٰ retain their ordinary syntax while their inventories contribute gathered water and quenching as a secondary material model.

activation_trace.role: A large gathered body of water makes knowledge a containing reservoir rather than an isolated datum.
The non-dominant quenching image casts sight as a field that fills and satisfies rather than merely touches a surface.
Overflowing water supplies the uncontrolled self-expansion that mistakes excess for independence.
Self-sufficiency names the false claim that the overflowing vessel needs no source or container.
Returning rain or water adds circulation and return to the hydraulic mechanism.
Nearness associated with seeking water redirects need toward approach rather than self-enclosure.

changed_reading.before: A self-sufficient subject is externally watched.
changed_reading.after: As a contained hydraulic analogy, the subject's overflow sits inside a larger reservoir and returning circulation; the gaze he ignores is also what exposes his unacknowledged need.

strongest_changes: The teaching and pen sequence turns the focus question from missing information into self-indictment by an imparted capacity.
Created attachment versus self-sufficiency makes the question expose a performed but impossible autonomy.
The ordered seeing forms reverse the subject's self-verdict by placing it inside human inspection and then divine sight.
The prohibition, worship, guidance, and denial sequence makes divine seeing a witness over rival claims to command.
The post-focus body, summons, and closing worship sequence gives the same gaze forensic, public, spatial, temporal, and protective valences.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact knowledge-seeing pair sustained several coexisting mechanisms rather than one omniscience gloss: disclosure, marked legibility, audience displacement, judgment, recursive optics, embodied evidence, social exposure, and protective oversight. Split-root branches also yielded report, optical-reflection, vertical, and hydraulic outliers that remain useful precisely when explicitly contained.
remaining_uncertainties: The implicit subject is underdetermined in the focus alone; context strongly specifies a prohibiting, denying, self-sufficient figure, but baseline models cannot assume all of those predicates.
The move from seeing to judgment or jurisdiction is abductive: branch inventories and sequence support it, but the directional force is supplied by the reader.
The non-dominant ر و ي and س ط ع mappings and the physical water, pupil, and inscription branches are exploratory resonances rather than claims about the focus words' direct lexical senses.
Divine seeing remains both threatening for coercion and protective for worship; the trace preserves rather than resolves those live valences.
